component.name: KonGUI
component.summary: Save, apply and share KDE Plasma configuration profiles

description.p: KonGUI is a graphical interface for Konsave. It saves the look and settings of your Plasma desktop as named profiles, applies them again, and exports or imports them as .knsv files to use on another computer.

ul.li: Choose which categories go into a profile: panels, themes, icons, fonts, shortcuts and more
Safety copies of the files a profile would replace, made before applying or importing
Works with the profile folder and .knsv files of Konsave
